Priya Sharma: Hi Sarah, thanks for picking up. This is Priya from Volopay.
Sarah Chen: Oh Priya! Yes, we were expecting your call. Our CFO Ravi is also on the line.
Ravi Patel: Hi Priya. We reviewed the proposal you sent last week.
Priya Sharma: Great! Any questions from your end?
Ravi Patel: We like the spend analytics dashboard. But we have 3 entities across India, Singapore, and Dubai. Can the platform handle multi-entity consolidation?
Priya Sharma: Absolutely. Multi-entity is a core feature. You can have separate entity wallets with consolidated reporting at the group level.
Sarah Chen: That's exactly what we need. What about local compliance? Singapore GST, UAE VAT?
Priya Sharma: Yes, our compliance module handles both. It auto-categorizes transactions for GST and VAT filing.
Ravi Patel: Impressive. What would be the implementation timeline for 3 entities?
Priya Sharma: Typically 4–6 weeks for full onboarding with 3 entities. We assign a dedicated implementation manager.
Ravi Patel: Good. We'll need to loop in our IT head before finalizing. Can you send a technical architecture document?
Priya Sharma: Of course, I'll send it today. Should we schedule a technical deep-dive call for next week?
Ravi Patel: Yes, please. Thursday works for us.
Priya Sharma: Perfect. I'll block Thursday 3 PM IST. Thank you both!

ai_summary.executive: Qualified discovery-to-proposal call with Bluewave Technologies CFO and Finance Director. Multi-entity support confirmed as a key requirement. Strong buying signals — requesting technical documentation and scheduling a follow-up technical deep-dive.
ai_summary.evidence: CFO Ravi Patel: 'We like the spend analytics dashboard... Can the platform handle multi-entity consolidation?' Confirmed follow-up: 'Can you send a technical architecture document?' and agreed to Thursday deep-dive.
ai_summary.negative_scope: No signed LOI or verbal commitment to purchase. IT head has not yet been consulted — technical blockers may emerge. Pricing negotiation has not commenced.

Sneha Patel: Hi Anand, Sneha here from Volopay. Do you have 10 minutes?
Anand Kumar: Sure, Sneha. We actually had a team discussion about your platform yesterday.

Anand Kumar: Right. But our finance team is asking about credit — can field cards run on a credit line rather than prepaid?
Sneha Patel: Yes, we offer corporate credit cards with a shared credit line. The limit is subject to an eligibility assessment.
Anand Kumar: What determines eligibility?
Sneha Patel: We look at company revenue, vintage, and banking history. Starfield Logistics should qualify for a decent limit given your scale.
Anand Kumar: Our last fiscal revenue was ₹85 crores. That should be fine, right?
Sneha Patel: That's encouraging — though final assessment is done by our credit team. I can initiate the credit assessment if you'd like.
Anand Kumar: Yes, please do. When can we expect a decision?
Sneha Patel: Typically 3–5 business days post application.
Anand Kumar: Alright. Send me the application link.
Sneha Patel: Will do immediately after this call!

Priya Sharma: Hi Deepak, Priya from Volopay. How are you finding the platform so far?
Deepak Nair: Honestly, Priya, we've had a rough week. Three of our card transactions were declined without any reason shown in the dashboard.
Priya Sharma: I'm really sorry to hear that, Deepak. Let me pull up your account. Can you share the transaction dates?
Deepak Nair: August 18, 19, and 20. All were vendor payments — all declined. We had credit available.
Priya Sharma: I can see them — these were declined due to a system-side velocity check that was incorrectly applied. This should not have happened.
Deepak Nair: We nearly missed a supplier payment because of this. This is serious.
Priya Sharma: Absolutely, I fully understand the severity. I'm escalating this right now to our payments ops team. You should receive a call within 2 hours.
Deepak Nair: Please make sure this doesn't happen again. We are in our first month of usage.
Priya Sharma: I give you my word. We'll also review the velocity configuration on your account and apply a fix today.
Deepak Nair: Alright. I'll wait for the ops team's call.

ai_summary.executive: Critical customer escalation — Quantum Energy Solutions experienced 3 transaction declines in their first month of use due to an incorrectly applied velocity check. Immediate escalation to payments ops required.
ai_summary.evidence: Deepak Nair: 'Three of our card transactions were declined without any reason shown.' Priya confirmed: 'declined due to a system-side velocity check that was incorrectly applied.'
ai_summary.negative_scope: Root cause is system-side, not user error. Fix not yet confirmed applied on this call. Customer satisfaction at serious risk given early-stage of relationship.
ai_summary.action_items: Priya Sharma to escalate to payments ops immediately — ops team to call Deepak Nair within 2 hours. Velocity config to be reviewed and fixed today. Incident to be documented for post-mortem.

Kavya Nair: Hi Mrs. Pillai, Kavya from Volopay. Is this a good time?
Mrs. Pillai: Kavya — I was about to call you. Our store managers cannot add receipts to transactions on the mobile app. It crashes every time.
Kavya Nair: I'm so sorry to hear that. When did this start?
Mrs. Pillai: Two days ago. It's affecting 24 store locations. Managers can't submit expense reports.
Kavya Nair: This is definitely a priority issue. I'm logging a P1 ticket right now. Can you tell me the device type and OS version?
Mrs. Pillai: All Android — mostly Samsung, Android 14.
Kavya Nair: Got it. Our engineering team has an open bug on receipt upload on Android 14. A patch was deployed yesterday — but it may need a force reinstall.
Mrs. Pillai: Nobody told us about this. We spent 2 days troubleshooting.
Kavya Nair: I sincerely apologize. I should have proactively informed you. I'll send the reinstall steps to all 24 store managers immediately. And I'll escalate for a credit on your next invoice for the disruption.
Mrs. Pillai: The credit would be appreciated. Please make sure this doesn't happen again.
Kavya Nair: Absolutely, Mrs. Pillai. I'll also ensure you're on our proactive incident notification list going forward.

ai_summary.executive: Customer escalation — Pinnacle Retail Chain (24 locations) experienced 2-day disruption due to Android 14 receipt upload crash bug. Patch exists; customer not proactively notified. Invoice credit offered.
ai_summary.evidence: Mrs. Pillai: 'Our store managers cannot add receipts to transactions on the mobile app. It crashes every time.' Kavya confirmed: 'Our engineering team has an open bug on receipt upload on Android 14.'
ai_summary.negative_scope: Credit amount not quantified. Whether all 24 managers will successfully reinstall is unconfirmed. Root cause of notification gap (no proactive comms) not addressed at process level.
ai_summary.action_items: Kavya Nair to send Android 14 reinstall instructions to all 24 Pinnacle store managers immediately. Initiate invoice credit with billing team. Add Pinnacle to proactive incident notification list. Manager: review proactive communication process for known bugs.
